whole_frame.interpretation: The whole-frame median average and p95 did not regress; the valid cumulative tail p99 crossed the unchanged frozen ceiling and remained above it in the later snapshots, with long frame maxima. This is an intermittent-tail pattern, not evidence of a sustained FPS/average-frame slowdown.

measured_stage_costs.interpretation: R7 kernel average is 0.558026 ms higher and kernel p95 0.25 ms higher. The R7 per-pixel composeVibeColor call executes inside the measured render/kernel path, so it is a plausible source of this modest sustained kernel cost, not a proven cause. AUX-prepare average rises 3.820484 ms while unaccounted average falls 3.760752 ms; their combined delta is only 0.059732 ms, consistent with timing bucket attribution moving rather than a comparable whole-frame penalty.

source_observation.r7_renderer: firmware/phase2/integration-r7/usermod/usermod_hbnf_foundation_v1.cpp:713 calls composeVibeColor from writePixel for rendered pixels.
source_observation.vibe_compositor: firmware/phase2/integration-r5/usermod/hbnf_vibe_runtime.h:129 onward; 860-byte routine in prior disassembly receipt.
source_observation.scope: The render stage timing encompasses kernel rendering; composeVibeColor itself has no separately captured per-call timing distribution. Existing source did not establish a path that explains isolated 55-73 ms frame tails.

exact_missing_evidence_for_causal_attrib: Timestamped per-frame durations from the qualification window, including the individual frames contributing to the >42.03125 ms p99 and 72.916 ms maximum.
Per-frame stage-resolved durations aligned to those same frame IDs (kernel/compositor, audio, scheduler/loop, AUX preparation/send), rather than once-per-second means/p95 snapshots.
A capture-path effect measurement at p99 on matched R4/R7, because the prior observer A/B established only a 3.739% frame-average delta.
decision: No source-backed p99 correction has been demonstrated. Preserve the R7 failure and exact R4 recovery. Do not build or install R8 from this evidence; first obtain event-level attribution through an offline replay source if available, or a newly authorized, safely instrumented live measurement.
